title: Inverse Proportionality Between Variables r and s
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: The variables r and s are inversely proportional, and r = 6 when s = 4. Determine s when r = 10.

steps.title: Write the Inverse Proportionality Relation
steps.explanation: Two variables r and s are inversely proportional if their product is a non-zero constant k, so s = k / r.
steps.why: Inverse proportionality means one variable varies directly with the reciprocal of the other.

steps.title: Solve for the Constant k
steps.explanation: Substitute the given values r = 6 and s = 4 to obtain k = 24, giving the formula s = 24 / r.
steps.why: The product rs remains invariant across all corresponding pairs (r, s).

steps.title: Evaluate s When r = 10
steps.explanation: Substitute r = 10 into s = 24 / r to find s = 2.4.
steps.why: Dividing the invariant product 24 by r = 10 yields the corresponding value of s.
